html: So Venus is a lot flatter than Earth, and even with a few deep trenches artificially created, the seas would likely never extend deeper than a 100 meters. So quick rule for sea life is to look at the life that evolved in shallow waters on Earth. Most of the things living on Venus that coudl be very large in the oceans would also have to be pretty flat, or hang out closer to the surface.
